story.title: ‘Sunrise On The Reaping’ Warming Up $83M+ 5-Day As Thanksgiving Stretch Box Office Sees $220M+ – Update
story.summary: 'Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping's is bound for the second best Thanksgiving stretch for franchise with $83M 5-day at domestic box office. Pic had second best Thanksgiving haul of franchise at $11.6M. SATURDAY AM: The Thanksgiving five-day stretch for all movies is coming in at an estimated at $220M+ per sources, which isn’t the worst we’ve seen post Covid; higher than 2021, 2022 and 2023, but certainly far off as we always expected from 2024’s $424.9M (-48%) and even last year’s fifth best ever ($290.3M, -24%). Thank God for Lionsgate , Suzanne Collins and Francis Lawrence for resuscitating The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping , which is now seeing a Wednesday-Sunday estimate of $83.5M , because Walt Disney Animation’s Hexed (with a $33M-$34M 5-day ) isn’t cutting it, and Universal/Paramount’s Ariana Grande-Ben Stiller-Robert De Niro Focker In-Law (coming in with $40.1M ) is…
